limits: Read-only static source reference; no network/game/production edits/checklist/ledger mutation/commit/push. Modern pinned 1.21 branch is not Forge1.20.1 source/API compatibility proof. Legacy click presence wins even if current click_action is valid. Wrongtyped legacy getString yields empty→NONE and suppresses current. Unknown/empty prefix returns NONE, no opaque retention. URI.create can throw during readData; BaseQuestFile catches exception per object but fields already assigned and later flags/dependency may remain partially initialized. fromString splits first colon; unknown/invalid type returns NONE. NONE detection writer uses identity rather than isNone, so NONE-like separately built action can emit none:data. Mixed old click not removed from reused caller compound; only actual fresh imageNBT writer proves omitted legacy keys. Actual conversion does not markDirty itself. Base fileVersion mismatch marks dirty; unrelated same-version legacy click may remain on disk until other save trigger. SNBT.write implementation, server save scheduling/atomicity, full network dispatch and persistence success not audited. ChapterImage declared STREAM_CODEC read/write is support only, not proof packet delivered. ChapterImage.shouldShowImage allows null dependency, including unresolved dependency id; editor bypasses gating in actual QuestPanel. Navigation target method resolves existence but does not itself enforce target task progression locks or claim rewards. No claim click grants/executes gameplay task. URI external opener, custom-event external listeners and FTBLibraryClientUtils.execClientCommand implementation not read/executed. No server command permission guarantee inferred. Recipe lookup/docs API are current options not additional legacy owners. showDocs split limit3 makes len>=4 anchor path unreachable; not used as proof full book routing. No per-player completion state/reward custody is migrated; authored image data only. Existing Chapter sequencing policy remains separate comparator and no additional image transform/render fields counted. BaseQuestFile loader source helper calls partly outside selected ranges are not new owner credits. Coordinator corrects original proposal page restriction: openQuest requires ANY nonnull currently viewed quest, not same target. setCurrentPage(long,int) stores by supplied targetID without equality check or clamp; getCurrentPage reads current questID and resets negative/out-of-range to0. Thus first navigation with no viewedquest may ignore page, but navigation from a different viewedquest can store requested target page. Full renderer/pageIndices construction/native runtime not audited. OPEN_QUEST does nothing if QuestScreen absent, logs unknown ID; config target lookup/navigation does not grant completion or bypass server reward checks. Modern upstream source is reference only. Original pinned archive metadata SHA checked and all actual source hashes checked; tree/source archive bytes not reacquired this turn, no fresh Git blob/tree verification claimed.
